t: You're on Grenville Place, a street in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. It runs from Cornwall Gardens and Launceston Place in the north down to Cromwell Road in the south. Along the way it's crossed by Cornwall Mews South, joined twice by Emperor's Gate on the west, and by Southwell Gardens on the east. The street takes its name from Dorothy Grenville, born in 1562. I don't have more on why she was chosen, so I'll leave it there.
